sources.vendors: the den's vendors: the supply trip is the climber's Holtburg trip (black-spawn-den-aluvian.json vendors; the draft listed Holtburg's and the Crater Lake shop has no scarab seller) M6 14 grocer (the owner, 2026-11-13: sell the empty flasks; live 2026-11-13 04:54 UTC: the supply trip named every Empty Flask outside Monyra the Jeweler's mask and kept it): Fispur Ansel the Grocer 714 (holtburggrocer) is the outskirts profile's row verbatim (holtburg-outskirts.json: guid 0x7A9B4024, cell and stop_cell 0xA9B4016A, his shop, point (78.9714, 38.5313, 94.005), buys_item_types 0x00446220 = Food 0x20 + Container 0x200 + Writable 0x2000 + Key 0x4000 + PromissoryNote 0x40000 + CraftCookingBase 0x400000, buy_price 0.9, no 'sells': a loot buyer only): SELECT li.guid, HEX(li.obj_Cell_Id), li.origin_X, li.origin_Y, li.origin_Z, i.value, f.value FROM landblock_instance li JOIN weenie_properties_int i ON i.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND i.type = 74 JOIN weenie_properties_float f ON f.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND f.type = 37 WHERE li.weenie_Class_Id = 714 (one row: 2056994852, A9B4016A, 78.9714, 38.5313, 94.005, 4481568, 0.9; a SELECT on the world copy, 2026-11-13). The Empty Flask (wcid 7940 flasksimple, ItemType 0x400000 CraftCookingBase, Value 1, MaxStackSize 1, so each one takes a slot; one is left by each potion she drinks, about 13 an hour) is in no other listed vendor's mask; ACE pays max(1, floor(0.9 x 1 + 0.1)) = 1 pyreal a flask (Vendor.cs GetBuyCost 591-599 @95ef426d). His MerchandiseMinValue (int 75) is 0 and his MerchandiseMaxValue (int 76) 1,000,000, and ACE's sale reads neither (Player_Commerce.cs VerifySellItems 232-298 @95ef426d: the mask, IsSellable, Retained, a Value of 1 or more, an empty container). Every other type of his mask is also Shopkeeper Renald the Elder's (0x480467A7), so he is listed after Renald: a tie of the loot buyers' counts goes to the profile's earlier row (ResupplyPlanner.LootBuyers), and that stays Renald. Her drinks (the Mana Potion 379, the Potion of Healing 377, the Health and Mana Tinctures 27319 and 27322) are Misc 0x80, outside his mask, and the sale keeps every drink she uses whatever a mask takes (ResupplyRun.DrinkInUse, m6-sale-keeps-drinks); a pack (Container) and a trade note are never offered (ResupplyRun.SaleItems). His stop is his own cell as Thelnoth's, Ecutha's and Monyra's are (the station's request stops ShopLeg.UnseenVendorReachMetres short of his point): the dat tests walk every vendor of the den's profile from Holtburg's lifestone, his leg among them (ResupplyRouteDatTests: the room graph's path, about 32 m, enters his shop through the room 0xA9B4016E and ends in 0xA9B4016A; VendorStopConfirmDatTests: the walker's pre-check confirms it and his point stands on the floor through the statics, and The_stations_walk_from_the_lifestone_to_the_Grocer_enters_his_shop_and_passes_the_pre_check plans the station's own request, his point with that range); the shop's two doors (0x7A9B401E and 0x7A9B401F, world objects the dats do not hold) and his body are not in those tests, and the walk to him has not been run live (TODO(m6-grocer-stop-point)). M6 sprint (2026-11-18; the live log of that day, 20:25:31 UTC: the learn step named Comfrey 767, Powdered Malachite 788, Dragonsblood 769, Hazel Talisman 746 and Powdered Turquoise 792 short, 'no vendor of Holtburg sells it', and at 20:29:54 the server refused Lifestone Recall for its components): Archmage Cindrue sells all five: SELECT id, weenie_Class_Id FROM weenie_properties_create_list WHERE object_Id = 2304 AND destination_Type = 4 AND weenie_Class_Id IN (746, 767, 769, 788, 792), read-only on the world copy, 2026-11-18: rows 21033 Hazel Talisman (Value 5), 20980 Comfrey (Value 10), 20982 Dragonsblood (Value 10), 21003 Powdered Malachite (Value 5) and 21007 Powdered Turquoise (Value 5), PropertyInt 19; price = max(1, ceil(1.35 x Value - 0.1)): 14 and 7. They are wares only, no stock line: the learn step's shopping list buys a component by the vendor's row, and the loader takes a spell component as a ware without a supply line (GroundCatalog.CheckSupplies); whether a trip keeps them in the pack for the recall is TODO(m6-recall-components-stock). The Gold Scarab 687 the same log names is no row of her list. Lifestone Recall (spell 1635) burns, on the full formula of the accounts test and qwinnie (the dats, HuntingGroundDatTests), the Copper Scarab, the Indigo and White Tapers, Comfrey, Turpeth, the Rowan Talisman and Powdered Malachite; the rows of her create list this profile still lacked are listed the same way (the same SELECT, 2026-11-18): Rowan Talisman 750 (row 21029, Value 5, 7), Turpeth 762 (row 21017, Value 5, 7), Indigo Taper 1647 (row 21041, Value 25, 34), White Taper 1652 (row 21044, Value 25, 34).
sources.spell_plan: M6 8 B1 (the brief; facts-fetch section 4, DB float rows 64-70 and 13-19): fire does nothing to Nubilous, Magma or Ember (resist 0, armor mod 100), so the plan is Frost Bolt VI from level 80 (the highest line the scrolls sell, the DB's spell row 74); the Cursed Wisp takes no cold (resist 0) and wants blade or lightning; those lines, and the fight's fire protection, are named in the section wants_known below (the fight casts only the fire line today: TODO(m6-fight-element-line), a loud stop, GroundWants). The spell book, attribute and body-part rows behind these targets' spells are the end-of-retail corpus rows (ace_world_end_of_retail, cited by facts-fetch.md); the lead confirms them by SELECT on the server's own database before the live round The wants_known section (M6 8 B1, facts-fetch section 4 (spell rows by id from the pinned world SQL v0.9.296, table spell): Frost Bolt VI 74 is the plan's line; Whirling Blade VI 97 (blade, resist 1.0) or Lightning Bolt VI 80 (0.9) are the lines for the Cursed Wisp, which takes no cold; Fire Protection Self VI 1094 answers Ember's melee fire and the Magma Golems' Flame Bolt IV; a line the book lacks is a loud line at the fight's start (GroundWants), never a silent fire bolt)
